sam_partnerships: Heads-up 3 Nimbus wants us to provide an attestation workflow + SKU taxonomy for their open model before they push to cloud marketplaces. Theyre asking for: (1) a hosted-only SKU, (2) a redistributable SKU, and (3) an SI-friendly offline installer bundle. Can legal confirm acceptable redistribution language?
rachel_legal: Quick note: we can do two-tier rights. Hosted-only = restricts download & redistribution. Redistributable = explicit terms + additional fees & indemnity. Need to add clause: 'No endorsement implied by Redwood.' Also must require partner to surface our attestation metadata intact.
tom_infra: Technical feasibility: yes. Proposed flow: compute checksums for each artifact, create provenance payload, sign with a KMS-backed ECDSA key. We'll produce: manifest.json, signature.sig, signer_kid header. For SI/offline: emit zipped artifacts + signed manifest and a signed-certificate.pem. We'll ship a static verifier binary.
emily_pm: Timeline ask: Nimbus PM wants marketplace tile live week of May 12, SI co-announce two weeks later. Marketing wants a 'Redwood Attested' badge. Logistics: we need SKU IDs for both tracks and clear pricing tiers.
harry_marketing: 'Redwood Attested' is good. Also suggest two tile variants: 'Hosted (Redwood Attested)' and 'Downloadable (Redwood Attested)'. We'll need copy that explains attestation vs endorsement.
olga_si: For SI bundles: many customers are air-gapped. The offline bundle must include: manifest.json, signature.sig, public_key.pem, verifier binary (linux x86_64 + arm64). Also need signer_kid + signer_version so SI installers can detect rotation.
ci_bot: signer-ci: build 3164078900 succeeded :white_check_mark: (artifact: signer-api:3164078900)
tom_infra: Implementation detail: manifest schema (rough):

```json
{
  "artifact_name": "nimbus-weights-v1.tar.gz",
  "artifact_sha256": "<hex>",
  "signer_kid": "redwood-signer-v2",
  "signer_version": "2026-05-01T12:00:00Z",
  "provenance_url": "https://artifacts.redwood/example/nimbus/v1/",
  "license_sku": "RLW-NIM-HOST-01"
}
```

Verifier will return non-zero exit code on mismatch. We'll publish verifier source + static bins.
sam_partnerships: Draft SKU mapping suggestion: 

SKU: RLW-NIM-HOST-01
 - Hosted inference (marketplace tile)
 - No downloads permitted
 - Attestation provided
 - Pricing: standard marketplace rev-share

SKU: RLW-NIM-DL-02
 - Hosted + downloadable weights
 - Redistributable add-on available (separate contract)
 - Attestation + redistrib license file in bundle

SKU: RLW-NIM-SI-03
 - SI installer (offline) + verifier binary + signer cert
 - Installer licensed for internal deployment; redistribution requires redistrib agreement

rachel_legal: Proposed contract language snippet for the SKU page: "Artifact attestation confirms the origin and integrity of distributed binaries. Attestation does not modify license rights. Redistribution beyond the scope of the purchased SKU requires a separate redistribution license and written approval from Redwood." Add non-endorsement line: "Partner and customer may not imply Redwood endorsement or partnership beyond the scope of the commercial agreement."
tom_infra: One more ops requirement: signer key rotation. We'll include signer_kid and a revocation list endpoint. Offline bundles will include the signer_version timestamp; verifier will check signer_version against a provided allowlist file for air-gapped cases.
emily_pm: Action items: Rachel finalize legal language by Thu EOD (3164078925). Tom drop manifest + verifier CLI spec + CI artifact by Fri. Harry to prepare badge art & tile copy. Sam to send SKU proposal to Nimbus PM and OLGA for SI acceptance.
olga_si: Also ask Nimbus SI: can they accept a SHA256 manifest or do they need SHA512? Many of our customers ask for SHA512 for extra caution.
harry_marketing: I'll mock two tile templates and three short badge options: 'Redwood Attested', 'Redwood Verified', 'Signed by Redwood'. Leaning to 'Redwood Attested' to avoid legal flavor.
sam_partnerships: Thanks all  I'll create a short runbook and ping Nimbus + SI contacts once legal + infra have drafts. :thumbsup:
